title: Publish eight-week Mindcraft roadmap
description: Create ROADMAP.md and docs/roadmap/issues.json, enable and provision GitHub Issues on logan-crosby/mindcraft, create roadmap labels, sprint milestones, four epics, and sixteen linked stories, then verify, commit, and push.
acceptance_criteria: Roadmap files are valid and linked; fork has 4 epics, 16 stories, 4 sprint milestones, 8 roadmap labels; each sprint totals 18 points; GitHub URLs resolve; changes are committed and pushed to fork/develop.
notes: Published roadmap to ROADMAP.md and docs/roadmap/issues.json. Enabled Issues on logan-crosby/mindcraft; created 8 labels, 4 sprint milestones, 4 epics (#1-#4), and 16 stories (#5-#20). Verified each sprint totals 18 points, every story has pillar/points/milestone/acceptance criteria/epic link, all 24 manifest URLs resolve, and sprint dependency chain is s1 -> s2 -> s3 -> s4.
close_reason: Eight-week roadmap published to disk and GitHub Issues; live and local verification passed.

title: Update GitHub username to logan-crosby
description: Replace active thesneakyk0ala Git/GitHub identity references with logan-crosby, update durable notes, preserve historical provenance, and verify push authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Global Git identity, GitHub CLI metadata, active repository remotes, current Beads actor fields, and durable identity note use logan-crosby; historical records are preserved; GitHub login and push behavior are verified.
notes: Updated global Git user.name, GitHub CLI account metadata, two active Claude command references, and nine repository remotes from thesneakyk0ala to logan-crosby. Added durable memory note. Verified gh api user and gh auth status resolve to logan-crosby, active configs contain no stale handle, Claude settings JSON is valid, and all remotes use the new handle. Upstream mindcraft-bots/mindcraft reports push=false, so direct push remains unavailable.
close_reason: Active GitHub identity references updated and verified; historical provenance preserved. Upstream push permission independently verified as unavailable.

title: Write repository contributor guide
description: Inspect the Mindcraft repository and replace the generated AGENTS.md scaffold with a concise, repository-specific contributor guide covering structure, commands, style, testing, and PR expectations.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md is titled Repository Guidelines, is 200-400 words, reflects actual repository commands and conventions, and passes a final content check.
notes: Implemented repository-specific AGENTS.md. Verified exact title, 376-word length, required commands, no test-framework misstatement, no apparent secret values, and clean git diff formatting. ESLint could not execute because no local/cached binary exists and network package execution was prohibited.
close_reason: Repository guide implemented and content checks completed; lint unavailable due environment dependency/network restrictions.
